resources.string: • 12 beveled pins numbered from 1 to 12,\n• 1 cylindrical thrower.
Be the first person/team to reach a score of exactly 50pts.
Arrange the game as shown on the home page.
From the throwing zone, toss the \"Mölkky\" (thrower) at the pins.
When a pin is completely flat, stand it up where its tip was. If it rests on another pin or the thrower, stand it up at its base location.
Knock down a single pin to score the value shown on it.
Knock down multiple pins to score the number of pins fallen.
Only pins lying completely flat are counted.
\"For example: to score 4pts, you can knock down pin number 4 (alone), or knock down 4 pins in one throw, regardless of their numbers.\"
If a player/team exceeds 50pts, their score drops back to 25pts.
If a player/team misses 3 consecutive throws, the next person in that team must skip their turn. The miss counter is then reset to zero.
\"For example: Manu throws 0pt, then Julie throws 0pt. If Manu throws 0pt again, Julie must skip her turn. If points are scored, the counter is reset.\"
When a person/team reaches exactly 50pts, the game ends.
MARINDODOUSH created this beautiful application (design, features).
The code was written by \"Gemini\" within \"Android Studio\".
Rules sheet (French only) downloadable with tips to build your own Mölkky set.

In the \"Who is playing?\" screen, enter the Alias of the players. If you want to save them, click the save icon (you can then edit, delete, or add them in the \"Alias\" tab on the home screen). Click the colored box to the right of the Alias to manually choose a team, or leave it blank for automatic distribution based on the team mode chosen at the bottom of this screen (indiv, 2, 3 or 4 teams).
Click on the colored box to the right of the Alias to choose the score achieved this turn. The score displayed in this box is the last score made by this person.
At any time, click on a player\'s NAME to see the details of their throws and their stats for the current session.
During a game, you can use your phone\'s back button to return to the home screen and check the rules without losing your current game. Click Start to resume.
